provenance.extraction: Page 1 (I-213) and page 2 (I-831) have no embedded text: fields and narrative were transcribed by hand from the page images, using Apple Vision OCR only as a draft. Pages 3-4 use embedded PDF text, with redaction labels placed by position.
provenance.verification: Case grouping (I-213 + continuation pages 2-4 of 4, header date 03/22/2017) and all transcribed fields were checked visually against the page images on 2026-10-29. The blank area before '7,' at the start of the page 2 narrative is recorded as [UNREADABLE].

selectedCharges.note: The source form shows charge code words 'I6A' and no statutory citation. The team assigned this citation so the citation check can be exercised. The mapping from 'I6A' to a citation is not assumed.
